hypothesis: Contraction of nonfarm payroll employment over the latest three known observation-months adds monotone information about a two-month unemployment rise beyond frequency alone.
model: sigmoid(logit(b)+beta*x); b=(past_target_events+1)/(past_target_cases+2); x=clip(log(PAYEMS(base-3)/PAYEMS(base))/log(1.01),-3,3); beta>=0 minimizes SUM historical Bernoulli negative log likelihood + beta^2/2 with offset logit(b) fixed
training_clock: historical-origin frozen claims features and base UNRATE; labels initially available by current cut only
acceptance: at least5percent lower paired Brier than BOTH frequency baselines and strictly lower than persistence; exploratory screen only, never automatic prospective admission
missing_policy: exclude from all compared scores; no imputation, no nonconsecutive weeks, no revised-current-history substitution
retuning: none; independent additional signal after failed claims variants; history already inspected and source headline viewed, adaptive exploratory only; no features/scales/windows/subsets selected by results.
solver: Derivative monotone; beta=0 if derivative at zero>=0; otherwise double upper bound from1 until derivative>=0 and run100 bisections.
reporting: All paired eligible months including pandemic; annual breakdown descriptive; comparison to earlier different samples forbidden; no choosing years.
payrolls_source: ALFRED PAYEMS monthly seasonally adjusted Thousands of Persons; all real-time intervals2011Jan–2026Sep, full source hash must be pinned in a private acquisition manifest before evaluation.
payrolls_requirement: At each historical cut25, latest available payrolls must match known unemployment base target-2months; require base and base-3, positive integer counts and complete audited monthly intervals.
